news.title: Analysis: Higher Treasury yields deliver a reality check on a hot, inflation-prone economy
news.summary: Elevated Treasury yields will complicate both Federal Reserve policy and Treasury financing. Federal Reserve will have to decide how to respond to rising Treasury yields. Treasury will also have to find a way to finance the rising yields.
